input.quote: This Agreement shall renew automatically thereafter for successive one year periods until terminated pursuant to Section 12 herein or unless either Client or TrueLink deliver to the other written notice of intent not to renew no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year.
input.rationale: Section 13 (p0078) is the only renewal mechanic: the initial term is one year and the Agreement renews automatically for successive one-year (not multi-year) periods, and either party — including Client — may stop renewal on written notice given no later than thirty (30) days before the end of the then-current year. The non-renewal notice window is therefore 30 days, inside both the preferred 30-day opt-out and the fallback 60-day ceiling, and well clear of the 90-day/multi-year walk-away triggers. No renewal price-uplift right exists: fees run off the Exhibit "A"/"B" schedules, Section 6 (p0047) freezes Hosting Services costs for the first year and adds a most-favoured-rate undertaking, and Section 16 permits amendment only by signed writing, so the conditional price-cap element is not triggered. The clause thus meets every fallback element and most preferred elements on its material terms; the only shortfalls are preferred-only sub-elements (no Vendor reminder 60 days before renewal and no express lesser-of-CPI-and-3% cap), which we note here rather than redline.
